name: L'Orologio Firenze
positioning: Watch-themed hotel with Florentine-style rooms, directly overlooking Piazza Santa Maria Novella in central Florence
best_for: Travelers who want a central Florence base on Piazza Santa Maria Novella
Couples looking for a suite with Duomo views or a private terrace

facts.text: The hotel directly overlooks Piazza Santa Maria Novella, home to one of the city's most important basilicas.
The Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Signoria, the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore with Giotto's bell tower and the Baptistery are within easy reach of the hotel.
The rooms are furnished in Florentine style.
The hotel has an exclusive collection of luxury watches.
Superior rooms are characterised by essential selections, geometric precision and fine furnishings.
Deluxe rooms overlook historic Florentine streets, with vistas such as the Croce al Trebbio, the Medici Chapels, the Canto di Mondragone and Forte Belvedere.
Some Deluxe rooms have views of the Piazza and Church of Santa Maria Novella or of the Florence Cathedral.
The hotel offers a Honeymoon Suite for romantic stays.
The hotel offers a Family Room for families travelling together.
The hotel has a sauna, a gym and a smoking room.
Bar de l'O is a bistro with intimate lighting, a large central mahogany bar and sitting areas with armchairs.

highlights.text: The Junior Suite is inspired by rare pieces in the vintage Vacheron Constantin and Rolex watch collections.
The Suite Rooftop Terrace is on the top floor, with a view of the Duomo and access to a large private terrace.
The hotel offers a Steel Suite with cathedral views.
Pets are accepted in the rooms and common spaces with no additional fee.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes compact room sizes typical of historic Florence properties.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site dining options.
